jen: quick notebringing up papercrane-v1 embeddings (float32 -> int6) in staging. ran parity holdout (short+long mix ~4.8k). saw recall@1 slip. anyone free to eyeball?

omar: numbers? batch/seq/index-norm?

jen: batch=1, seq<=10, no index-norm. float32 recall@1=0.883 -> int6 per-tensor 0.798; per-channel 0.821. recall@10 holds at 0.968 -> 0.961.

lina: tail sensitivity again?

jen: yep. freq tail (<15) drops from 0.85 -> 0.63. head stable. mean L2 float=1.04 -> int6=0.74. cosine histogram narrows.

guillermo: try index-time L2 normalize and run nf4 as comparison.

jen: did quick index-l2norm run: recall@1 -> 0.877 (close). write latency +1ms median. per-channel+clip (99.9) -> 0.828. nf4 pending.

omar: sounds like angle-preserving fix works. ops-bot: pause papercrane-v1-int6 rollout in staging.

ops-bot: rollout paused for papercrane-v1-int6 in staging flagged by eng-ml (reason: recall@1 regression on mixed holdout).

lina: next steps: a) run nf4 vs int6 per-channel b) produce per-query diffs and top-k flip histogram c) add more short-query templates to holdout.

jen: I'll open a tiny PR with harness, diffs, and table below. cc @omar @lina @guillermo

--- quick table ---
float32: recall@1=0.883 recall@10=0.968 mean_L2=1.04
int6 (per-tensor): recall@1=0.798 recall@10=0.961 mean_L2=0.74
int6 (per-channel): recall@1=0.821 recall@10=0.964 mean_L2=0.90
int6 + index-l2norm: recall@1=0.877 recall@10=0.967 mean_L2=1.00

omar: thanks I'll queue nf4 runs and a lang-parity check.
